triggers.detailsText: the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on 6th November, 2026, considered and approved raising of funds through the issuance of fully paid-up equity shares of the Company of the face value of Rs 10/- each by way of a rights issue (the "Rights Issue") for an amount not exceeding Rs 1450 Crore (Rupees One Thousand Four Hundred and Fifty… Further, pursuant to the in-principle approval received from BSE Limited (“BSE”) and National Stock Exchange of India Limited (“NSE”), the Board of Directors has today fixed a rights issue price of Rs 3,506 (Rupees Three Thousand Five Hundred and Six Only) per fully paid-up Rights Equity Share, leading to an entitlement of 2 (Two) fully paid-up Rights… The proceeds of the Rights Issue will primarily be utilised towards financing the acquisition of Mahindra Truck and Bus Division (MTBD) and supporting strategic growth initiatives aimed at building an integrated and future-ready commercial vehicle platform.
filingKeyFacts: the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on 6th November, 2026, considered and approved raising of funds through the issuance of fully paid-up equity shares of the Company of the face value of Rs 10/- each by way of a rights issue (the "Rights Issue") for an amount not exceeding Rs 1450 Crore (Rupees One Thousand Four Hundred and Fifty…

Further, pursuant to the in-principle approval received from BSE Limited (“BSE”) and National Stock Exchange of India Limited (“NSE”), the Board of Directors has today fixed a rights issue price of Rs 3,506 (Rupees Three Thousand Five Hundred and Six Only) per fully paid-up Rights Equity Share, leading to an entitlement of 2 (Two) fully paid-up Rights…

The proceeds of the Rights Issue will primarily be utilised towards financing the acquisition of Mahindra Truck and Bus Division (MTBD) and supporting strategic growth initiatives aimed at building an integrated and future-ready commercial vehicle platform.

triggers.detailsText: Era Infra Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Clarification regarding the appointment of the Compliance Officer of the Company.' In this regard, we wish to clarify that Ms. Arunima Trigunayat was appointed as the Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company with effect from May 12, 2025, pursuant to the approval of the Board under Section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013.Upon relisting of the Company's securities on the recognised stock exchanges in December 2025, Ms. Arunima Trigunayat, being the existing Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company, was entrusted with the responsibilities of the Compliance Officer in terms of Regulation 6(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Accordingly, no separate announcement was made in respect of her appointment dated May 12, 2025, as the Company was not listed on the said date.However, pursuant to the advice of the Stock Exchange, the Company is now making the requisite announcement in this regard for your information and records.We request you to kindly take the above clarification on record.
